title: Speculation Rules: Hidden Prerender to Activation
description: Trace how moderate eagerness prerenders a target route in a hidden context and swaps it on click.

steps.label: 1. Pointer Hover (moderate eagerness)
steps.description: User hovers over /checkout for 200ms. Speculation Rules queues a background prerender.

steps.label: 2. Background Render & Restricted APIs
steps.description: Engine parses HTML, fetches CSS/JS, and paints in memory. Permissions, audio, and modals are deferred.

steps.label: 3. Click & Atomic Activation
steps.description: User clicks the link. The hidden context swaps in at 0ms network wait and fires prerenderingchange.
